name: trackmyjourney-workspace
description: TrackMyJourney - Live Train Tracking & Route Explorer

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const cmd = isWin ? 'cmd.exe' : 'npm'; const args1 = isWin ? ['/c', 'npm', '--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'] : ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev']; const args2 = isWin ? ['/c', 'npm', '--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'] : ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev']; const s = spawn(cmd, args1, { stdio: 'inherit' }); const c = spawn(cmd, args2, { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
